Name: Buyable Dragon Teeth
Author: shalassa
Description:
Are you tired from grinding dozens of lava lurks for their teeth?
Do you want to have a more pacifist run, and don't want to run through the volcano hundreds of times to find the skeletons?
Do you have too many cinder shards lying around, not knowing what to do with them?


Now there is a solution to all those questions: [b]Purchasable Dragon Teeth[/b]!


This tiny mod adds dragon teeth to the dwarf's shop in the volcano. The default price is 200 cinder shards each, with a config option for 100, 150, 250, and 400.


[b][u]Requirements

[/u][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿ (not strictly necessary but highly recommended to always have installed for mods with configs)



[b][u]Installation[/u][/b]

Just copy the unzipped (!) folder into your Mods folder, or let your favourite mod manager do the work for you.



[b][u]Uninstallation[/u][/b]

Just remove the folder from your Mods folder, or just delete it with your favourite mod manager.



[b][u]Compatability[/u][/b]

Should be compatible with everything, including other shop overhauls. You might end up with two options for dragon teeth.
